title: Window Of Perspectives
description:
Everyday we can get glimpses at others life through their windows, but what you understand is up to your own perspective.

In Window of Perspectives, you're tasked to review tapes send by an unknown organisation from the perspective of a window and much more.

 Discover an anthology of small stories through simple puzzle solving.  

• Find clues hidden in those tapes to understand the situation.

• Connect them to gather more information with a Search fonction.

• Decide if they are simple everyday situations or accept a stranger and darker reality.

• Your interpretation may alter future tapes and have other consequences.
All of this can be changed dynamicaly and easily at anytime.

Only a mouse is required. 
Only available in English.

This game is 100% made without any form of AI, our mistake are human like our stories and the devs are Human Idiots.
description_short: Play as a contractor for a mysterious organization in a new mystery point and click. You're tasked to review tapes and complete reports about strange situations. Find clues, connect dots, choose what you want to believe and influence the world.
